author: nonretail_writer
central_thesis: Flat October CPI and the biggest PPI drop since 2020 pushed US Treasuries into a 20-observation bull flattening (2Y -31 bps, 10Y -53 bps) and the dollar lower, and equities have already priced a Fed that is done, with the VIX at 14.32. The next leg depends on whether the consumer slowdown signalled by falling October retail sales and Walmart's cautious outlook stays orderly, so we favour duration, margin-repair quality, rate-sensitive utilities/REITs and Polish banks backed by a strong zloty, and stay underweight energy, European autos and China platforms exposed to the US chip regime.
sources_policy: Facts come only from the 2023-11-17 frozen digest (headlines published before 2023-11-17T00:00Z, windows: company news 7 days, company results 14 days, macro/policy 35 days) and the 2023-11-17 writer market card; numbers are card values or appear in a headline cited in the same part; no spot-FX numbers; currency direction only from cited headlines; previews are not used as results.
known_ambiguities_omitted: n0930: CNBC headline on Alibaba Hong Kong shares dropping 10% describes the 2023-11-17 Hong Kong session (card shows 9988.HK -2.22% on 2023-11-16); post-cutoff, not used.
n2230: CNBC "Dollar posts steep weekly fall, yen trades below 150" reads as a Friday weekly wrap and quotes a numeric FX level; not used.
n0992: CNBC "Gap shares surge more than 30%" may describe the 2023-11-17 session after the 2023-11-16 after-hours report; not used.
n1528, n1304: aggregate UAW Big Three ratification results likely announced on 2023-11-17; not used. n0939, n1521, n1529 (GM ratification) have ambiguous evening timing; not used.
n1013: "Marathon Digital up 12%" conflicts with the card (MARA -4.69% on 2023-11-16); not used.
n1559: "Japanese yen jumps against dollar" dated 2023-11-13 precedes the CPI-driven move; ambiguous timing, not used.
n1854: Money.pl item on a parliament passing a 2024 budget with a record deficit refers to Ukraine, not Poland; not used for Polish fiscal claims.
Date-level timestamps earlier than the event they report (n0025 RBA decision, n1568 Japan GDP, n0208/n0209 China October data); the events themselves precede the cutoff and are used.
Cisco and Allegro single-session drops are quoted from the card without attributing an unreported cause.
